regime_context: China A-shares detector shows a narrow, one-narrative tape: only Coal (rank 1) and Banks (rank 3) pass the absolute-trend eligibility gate, with rotation breadth at just 0.09 and absorption at 0.34. Critically, gate_helps=false for this market — the trend discipline did NOT cut drawdown on China history, and cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0, so the reads are display-only and must be held at low conviction. Track record (58 calls, 52% hit rate, 0.337 directional accuracy) supports humility.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the dominant one-narrative leader (rank 1, score 0.992) and the only scorable eligible theme alongside Banks. Durability bar 0.52 is modest, breadth 0.5 is half the sector, and hurst_tag is mean-revert — meaning the trend leg is the weakest pillar of the read. The lean rests almost entirely on current leadership/attention (focus lens, not alpha) plus eligibility, not on durable trend health or rotation breadth.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst_tag plus thin 0.5 breadth means this leadership may be a whip, and gate_helps=false on this market says absolute-trend eligibility has no drawdown edge here — the 'eligible' flag is not a validated forward signal.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the second scorable eligible theme (rank 3, score 0.932) with the strongest durability bar in the entire universe (0.83) and full breadth (1.0), suggesting genuine broad participation rather than a narrow squeeze. However crowding_z 1.83 flags crowded=true, which is a SIZE-DOWN caution only — not a fade. The lean is a directional nod to the only other eligible theme, tempered by crowding and the fact that eligibility has no validated edge on this mean-reverting market.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.83 is the highest among eligible themes — attention/flow concentration at a possible top; and on a mean-reverting China tape the absolute-trend gate has no historical drawdown edge, so the eligibility flag is weaker than it appears.
